info.name: API Reference Associated Persons policyAmendmentIntents API

request.description: Confirms a policy amendment intent after the employee has reviewed and accepted the quote. The intent must be in `pending_confirmation` status with a valid quote. The confirmation deadline must not have passed.
Cancels a policy amendment intent when the employee decides not to proceed. Can only cancel intents in `action_required` or `pending_confirmation` status.

item.name: Create a dependents management intent for a policy amendment

request.description: Creates a dependents management intent as a sub-intent of a policy amendment intent. The sub-intent allows the platform to add or remove dependents from the policy. The policy amendment intent must be in `action_required` status with a `dependents` requested change.

response.name: OK

item.name: List all policy amendment intents for a policy

query.description: Multiple values can be provided by separating them with a comma. Allowed values are: `action_required`, `awaiting_quote`, `pending_confirmation`, `processing`, `amended`, `processing_error`, `not_undertaken`.
The page of results to return. Defaults to 1 if not provided.
The number of results to return per page. Defaults to 10 if not provided. Maximum value is 100.

item.name: Create a new policy amendment intent

request.description: Initiates a policy amendment (e.g. adding/removing dependents). The intent coordinates the amendment workflow including dependents sub-intent management, quote generation, employee confirmation, and provider processing.
